data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 abstracts the shared digit-allocation mechanism of SRC_002, SRC_003, SRC_004, and SRC_006 into a single cumulative digit-usage function D(n) = 9×1 + 90×2 + (n−99)×3. The piecewise-linear formulation is a direct abstraction of the arithmetic division shown in the other endpoints, reducing the stepwise digit-allocation to an invertible function. This abstraction is refuted if the function D(n) does not share mechanism with the arithmetic computation in SRC_002 and SRC_003, or if the linear formula cannot be reduced to the identical 9 + 90 + 201 sum used in the other derivations.
